correctness.rationale: An arbitrary triple has valuations u,u,v. Dephasing gives a four-chord determinant identity whose argument forces N|(a-b)(c-d). Exact factorization gives the rank 2 criterion; a 2x2 minor excludes rank 1 in that case. Unique closest-pair counting gives B_m=N^3/2^(u+v+3). Domination of geometric tails yields N X_m->8/3 and N I_m->0, hence S_m/N^5->1/12 and probability ~3/N. Boundary equality, quantifiers and complex ranks were checked. A standalone exact cyclotomic verifier agrees in 342752 cases.
